minLoanAmount.note: Verbatim: "loan amounts of between $5,000 and $3,000,000". This is below the usual plausibility floor for a home loan minimum, but it is what the TMD says — the Home Owners Package is a mortgage-secured facility that also covers equity access and personal/domestic asset purchases.

notes.value: REBRAND: Warwick Credit Union Ltd has traded as Darling Downs Bank since 1 September 2025 — the legal entity, ABN 98 087 651 116 and ACL 240556 are unchanged, only the brand. Founded in Warwick in 1970, serving Allora, Dalby, Gympie, Killarney, Inglewood, Warwick and Toowoomba in southern Queensland. Broker-distributed: the TMD names branches, call centre, online and brokers as the distribution channels and states "There are no other distributors for this product." The Home Owners Package is the flagship owner-occupier product: variable, fixed or combination, interest-only or P&I, weekly/fortnightly/monthly repayments, progressive drawdowns, additional repayments capped at $20,000 on fixed-rate loans, plus a 0.10% bonus on carded term deposit rates. Establishment fee, annual package fee and external fees apply.
notes.sourceTitle: Darling Downs Bank Target Market Determination — Home Owners Package Owner Occupier, 1 May 2026
notes.note: Rebrand date sourced separately from Warwick Today (29 July 2025) and Australian Rural & Regional News (8 August 2025); the TMD itself carries the dual name 'Warwick Credit Union Ltd T/A Darling Downs Bank'.

gaps: The 'warwick-credit-union' id is retained as the join key, but the brand is now Darling Downs Bank (ddbank.com.au) — a search for 'Warwick Credit Union' will not find current policy documents.
No servicing buffer, assessment floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, HEM basis or commitment treatment published.
No income-type policy published at all.
No security policy beyond 'registered first mortgage over real property' — no unit size, postcode, high-density, rural or land-size rules.
Only the Owner Occupier Home Owners Package TMD was read; an investment equivalent and other loan products exist and were not researched — investor LVR and loan sizes are unknown.
No LMI provider named and no LMI waiver professions published.
Offset availability not established (the TMD names redraw and progressive drawdowns but not an offset account).
